list.title: Law Structure
list.empty: No law group, law, or requirement has been created.

import.title: Import requirements from Excel
import.help: Download the template and fill in the «الزامات» sheet. Only the requirement title is required; blank codes are generated automatically. Optional dates accept Persian text such as 1405/08/06 or Gregorian text such as 2026-10-28. Each file supports up to 500 requirements and 2 MB.
import.previewReady: The file is valid. {{count}} requirements are ready to save.
import.confirmHelp: Saving applies every row to this law. The last column shows each row's operation. No changes are saved before confirmation.
import.success: {{count}} requirements were saved for this law.
import.invalid: The file has {{count}} errors. Correct the following cells in Excel and select the file again.
import.finishEdit: Save or leave law editing before importing an Excel file.
import.emptyList: No requirements have been registered for this law.
import.stale: The file or records changed after preview. Validate and preview again.
import.hierarchyBusy: The law structure is being changed. Validate again shortly.
import.forbidden: You do not have permission to import requirements.
import.failed: Requirements could not be imported. Validate the file again.
import.refreshFailed: Saving succeeded, but the list could not be refreshed. Refresh to see the result; do not save again.

issues.FILE_FORMAT: Use an .xlsx workbook based on the provided template. Keep the «الزامات» sheet and its column headings unchanged.
issues.FILE_SIZE: The file must not be empty or exceed 2 MB.
issues.HEADERS: Keep the six column headings and their order exactly as in the template. Merged cells are not supported.
issues.ROW_LIMIT: Each file supports up to 500 requirements. Keep data rows near the top of the sheet.
issues.EMPTY: Enter at least one requirement in the «الزامات» sheet.
issues.EXTRA_COLUMN: Data was entered outside the template columns.
issues.FORMULA_NOT_ALLOWED: This cell contains a formula. Use Paste Values to enter its final value.
issues.INVALID_CELL: Enter text or a number appropriate for this column.
issues.TITLE_LENGTH: Requirement titles support up to 255 characters.
issues.CODE_LENGTH: Shorten the code to 64 UTF-8 bytes or leave it blank for automatic generation.
issues.SORT_ORDER: Enter a whole number from 0 to 2147483647, or leave blank to use the row order.
issues.DATE: Enter a valid Persian date as text, such as 1405/08/06, or Gregorian date text such as 2026-10-28.
issues.DATE_RANGE: Valid to must not precede valid from.
issues.DUPLICATE_FILE_CODE: This code is repeated in another row of this file.
issues.DUPLICATE_CODE: An active requirement with this code already exists. Correct the code or remove the row.
issues.OTHER_REGULATION: This code belongs to a requirement of a different law. Enter another code.
